text:
anya: Heads up — compliance report flagged a permission change on project-gateway where actor is null (audit_id 0x7f9b2). Anyone seen a related RBAC rollout today? :eyes:
matt: Not me. Which report? https://reports.internal.redwood/compliance/2025-11-13/summary — it highlights a missing principal on a role update.
carla: Saw an automated role-refactor PR merged this morning by rbac-syncer. It normally writes principal=bot:rbac-syncer but this event shows null.
sec-bot: Auto-alert: audit_event 0x7f9b2 missing principal. Ingest pipeline recorded consumer restart around event time. Recommend verifying kafka offsets and KMS decrypt attempts.
anya: Could be ingest pipeline backfill or sampling config change. @devops-oncall can you check kafka topic audit-events and the consumer offsets around 07:12 UTC? Also check KMS key rotation logs — we rotated alias/redwood-audit last week.
devops-oncall: Checking offsets now. Quick checks: kafka topic shows a gap (partition 3) 07:11:33-07:13:50. Consumer group audit-ingest had a restart at 07:12:01. Pasting commands I'm running:
```bash
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group audit-ingest --describe
```
matt: If consumer restarted during KMS rotation, decrypt step might've failed and we wrote partial event with principal null. Querying DB for similar partial events:
```sql
SELECT id, ts, payload->>'principal' as principal, metadata->>'ingest_version' FROM audit_events
WHERE ts >= '2025-11-13'::timestamp - interval '1 hour' AND (payload->>'principal') IS NULL
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
```
carla: Also confirm KMS access logs: cloudtrail shows a GenerateDataKey call at 07:12:00 by service-role/audit-ingest. But there is a FailedDecrypt at 07:12:03 from same host.
anya: If it's ingest issue, compliance needs proof chain. We must either backfill actor info from original event source (service logs) or mark as 'no author found' with rationale. Compliance deadline EOD Friday.
devops-oncall: Offset gap might mean some messages never made it to the db. I can reprocess from kafka offsets if we still have segments. Before reprocessing, I'll snapshot current ingest DB table. Running:
```bash
db_dump audit_events --filter "ts > '2025-11-13' - interval '2 hours'" > /tmp/audit_snapshot.sql
```
matt: I can write a reprocessor that attempts to decrypt with alternate key and map principal using headers. Sketch:
```python
# pseudo
for msg in kafka.consume(start_offset):
    try:
        ev = decrypt(msg.payload)
        store(ev)
    except DecryptError:
        ev = parse_partial(msg)
        ev.principal = msg.headers.get('x-original-principal')
        store(ev)
```
carla: :thumbsup: If reprocess fails, we need an attestation doc for compliance. I'll draft rationale and include the CloudTrail/GCP audit IDs. Can someone paste the audit_event id 0x7f9b2 full payload?
anya: Here it is (sanitized):
```
{"id":"0x7f9b2","ts":"2025-11-13T07:12:02Z","resource":"role:update","payload":{"role":"gateway-admin","changes":[{"perm":"write","from":false,"to":true}],"principal":null},"ingest_version":"v2.3","host":"ingest-01"}
```
sec-bot: Note: if we re-ingest and actor is still null, compliance requires escalation to CISO and automatic 7-day frozen window for related accounts.
devops-oncall: I've found retained kafka segment; starting reprocess now. I'll post results. @matt @carla please prepare backfill scripts and attestation.
anya: Thanks. Also add a ticket in compliance tracker and cc legal. I'll update the compliance dashboard with in-progress flag.
